faqSectionTitle: Frequently Asked Questions: Enterprise Automation & Integration
q1: Which ERP and CRM platforms can be integrated with our web infrastructure?
a1: WebABC engineers custom bi-directional integrations with both leading regional accounting suites (Sepidar System, Rahkaran / System Group) and global enterprise solutions (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP). We build against official REST APIs, secure webhooks, and direct database endpoints.
q2: How do you guarantee transaction integrity and prevent webhook failures during outages?
a2: We utilize robust message queuing architectures (RabbitMQ / Redis) with idempotent endpoints and exponential backoff retry algorithms. If your internal accounting server or internet connection experiences downtime, transactions are safely buffered in the queue and executed sequentially once restored.
q3: How much turnaround time does an automated quote-to-invoice pipeline save?
a3: Workflows that traditionally took 1 to 3 business days of manual back-and-forth emails, spreadsheet recalculations, and managerial signatures are compressed into real-time seconds. Orders automatically allocate inventory, calculate volume tiers, apply VAT regulations, and emit signed invoices.
q4: How is customer confidentiality and financial transaction security maintained?
a4: All data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.3, verified with cryptographic HMAC payload signatures, and governed by strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). In addition, server-to-server middleware communicates through IP whitelisting to eliminate unauthorized surface exposure.
